title: Governed by default: how data teams at Nordstrom turn dbt governance into an AI advantage
description:
How Nordstrom governs 1,000+ DAGs on dbt with contracts and the dbt MCP server to keep AI from confidently guessing wrong. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Nadine Bruxel, head of data insights platform, and Priya Tanwar, principal engineer, explain how Nordstrom treated governance as the AI unlock itself. They built a multi-agent data development lifecycle on dbt tests, contracts, and lineage. Five months after onboarding to dbt, pipeline builds that used to take weeks ship in days. Their advice: put tests, contracts, and lineage in place early, because they become the control surface for whatever AI you add.

In this session you'll learn:
• Why governance enables AI instead of slowing it down
• How a multi-agent development lifecycle works on dbt
• What to put in place first when starting out

Speakers: Nadine Bruxel, head of data insights platform; Priya Tanwar, principal engineer; Nordstrom

Learn more about dbt and AI: https://www.getdbt.com/product/ai

#dbt #dbtSummit2026 #DataGovernance
